_comment: The one place the installer learns which discs it supports. The recompiler's seeds, the spin-wait list, the patch list and the guest addresses in src/game are all addresses in one exact default.xbe, so each build is its own program: ntsc-u-retail is the default, pal-retail the one made with BO3_REGION=PAL (regen.sh, cmake -DBO3_REGION=PAL; config/pal/ and the second values of src/game/region.h's BO3_VA, written by tools/region/), pal-ensv-retail the one made with BO3_REGION=PAL-ENSV (config/pal-ensv/, the third values). All three are one package (package: takedawn, in this order): the main program is the first one's, the others lie beside it with their program suffix after its name (Takedawn-pal, takedawn-ensv, libmain_pal.so), and each program starts the one whose disc is installed (src/game/package.c, src/game/install.c). user_dir is the per-user folders' name of the build's program (src/game/install.h BO3_USER_DIR; the two PAL programs share theirs). Any other build (Japan, a patched or trimmed XBE) must be refused, not tried. To support another build, add an entry here AND regenerate/verify against it.
